Subject: Realtime stream silence during peak bursts — intermittent and customer-visible

Hi Logan / Redwood support,

We're seeing repeated incidents during our morning spikes where the model starts streaming and then stops sending tokens for ~6-30s before resuming, or the WS connection drops with a 504 at the proxy. This is happening for a subset of requests when our aggregate throughput hits ~200-300 req/s. It impacts our live chat UX (clients see frozen responses). We've attached a PCAP and a short log excerpt.

Examples: 2027-02-12T08:48:14Z (request id: cp-7a4b), 2027-02-12T08:53:22Z (request id: cp-7c1f). In the traces we see chunked transfer beginning then silence; NGINX shows upstream timed out. Can you triage urgently — this is customer-facing and we've escalated internally.

Thanks,
Clara Jensen
Platform Lead, ClearPath AI

Subject: Re: Realtime stream silence during peak bursts — initial SRE findings

Quick update from SRE: I looked through the PCAP and your chunk logs. Two immediate observations:

1) The token stream (chunked chunks with Transfer-Encoding: chunked) starts correctly but several streams show an abrupt pause where the TCP session remains open and no data is pushed for multiple seconds. Upstream model process is still listed as running.

2) NGINX error logs around the same timestamps show repeated "upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out)" and occasional 502/504 propagated to the client. The proxy has proxy_buffering on by default in this stack; that interacts poorly with long-lived streaming responses when upstream flushes are irregular.

Attachments: nginx_error_snippet.txt (excerpt). Next steps proposed:
- Reproduce in our staging with a traffic generator that simulates bursty arrivals and long outputs.
- Temporarily disable proxy_buffering on the path to your instances and observe whether silence disappears.
- Add keepalive pings (application-level heartbeats) as a fallback to detect stalls sooner on the client.

I'll prepare a yaml config diff for the proxy change and propose a 30-minute canary window tomorrow morning. If that removes the behavior we ship a patch to our gateway fleet.

— Marcus
SRE Engineer

Subject: Exec summary + mitigation plan — ClearPath production impact

Clara / team — thanks for flagging and for the packet captures. Short exec summary:
- Symptom: intermittent token stream silence and occasional WS/504 for a subset of high-throughput requests during burst windows.
- Probable cause: proxy buffering + upstream flush irregularity causing the L7 proxy to time out or buffer chunks until connection timers fire.

We are prioritizing a hotfix:
1) Immediate canary: disable proxy_buffering for ClearPath traffic path, deploy to a small subset of gateways during your peak tomorrow.
2) If canary successful: roll change to US fleet and schedule EU rollout; follow-up: increase monitoring (per-request idle time metric) and add an alert that triggers at 3s of stream silence.
3) Customer compensation: one-day service credit for user-visible degradations, plus a joint postmortem.

We own the deployment and will coordinate a tight maintenance window; please confirm a 30-min slot tomorrow between 08:30-09:15 PST for the canary.

— Rishi Malhotra
VP Engineering, Redwood Inference
